DrawOpaqueInterior(IRenderer)

Draws the opaque interior of this osu.Framework.Graphics.DrawNode to the screen, if osu.Framework.Graphics.DrawNode.CanDrawOpaqueInterior indicates that an opaque interior can be drawn. The opaque interior must be a fully-opaque, non-blended area of this osu.Framework.Graphics.DrawNode, clipped to the current masking area via 

DrawClipped()
. See osu.Framework.Graphics.Sprites.SpriteDrawNode for an example implementation.
